logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-03 verification memo (data-center compute node selection). Left panel: a clean horizontal bar chart of verified energy per acceptance batch on the shared test basis, drawn exactly to scale with a gridline every 10 Wh: P3 10 Wh, P2 22 Wh, P1 28 Wh, P4 49 Wh; all bars in one neutral accent color so no candidate is visually singled out; annotate successive gaps 12 Wh, 6 Wh, 21 Wh and the 39 Wh winner-to-last spread. Right panel: a four-step independent verification workflow (recompute eligibility, rank energy, audit analyst prose against the trusted table, record open questions) ending at the policy pick P3. White background, sans-serif labels, no decorative extras, no tag-like strings.
